name: Blackhead Suction Remover Portable Pore Cleaner with LED Display and Multiple Suction Levels
description:
Achieve clear, radiant, and healthy skin with the Electric Blackhead Suction Remover. Designed with advanced vacuum technology, it effectively removes blackheads, whiteheads, dead skin, excess oil, and makeup residue. Featuring 3 adjustable suction levels and 5 interchangeable probes, it adapts to all skin types. The built-in LED light ensures precision, while the rechargeable USB battery makes it portable and convenient for home or travel use. An excellent addition to any skincare routine.
Key Features:
 Material: Eco-friendly ABS, safe and non-toxic
 Suction Levels: 3 adjustable modes for sensitive, normal, and oily skin
 Probes: 5 interchangeable heads for blackheads, dirt, and fine lines
 Battery: USB rechargeable, lasts up to 2 hours per charge
 Display: LED screen shows suction level and battery status
 Integrated LED light for clearer skin care visibility
How to Use:
 Wash face with warm water or steam for 5–10 minutes to open pores
 Select probe and suction level according to skin type
 Glide device gently over targeted areas (avoid staying too long on one spot)
 After use, cleanse skin and apply moisturizer or pore care essence
 Clean probes after each use for hygiene
Safety Information:
 Do not use on damaged, inflamed, or broken skin
 Start with the lowest suction level for first-time use
 Limit usage to 1–2 times per week
 Keep out of reach of children
Package Includes:
 1 × Electric Blackhead Suction Remover Device
 5 × Interchangeable Probes
 1 × USB Charging Cable
